elements.element: The transition and data-return obligations are triggered upon either expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added language begins: “Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, Vendor shall...”
Clause (a) requires Vendor to “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) specifies assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Vendor must return all Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires Vendor to “return all Customer Data.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires return “within 30 days after expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) expressly requires “a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) requires Vendor to “thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion after the Customer Data is returned and deleted.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) requires Vendor to “certify such deletion in writing” after the return obligation in clause (b).

elements.element: The fallback transition-assistance and data-export obligations are triggered upon either expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added language applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement.”
Clause (a) requires Vendor to “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available “for up to six (6) months,” which encompasses the fallback 90-day period.
Requiring Vendor to return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format provides the required data export.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires return in the exportable format “within 30 days after expiry or termination.”

result.reason: The operative redline implements every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It leaves the existing payment, delivery, and refund terms intact and adds only the requested exit obligations. Drafting is generally clear, though “thereafter” gives no express deadline for deletion or certification and “for up to six months” could be clearer about whether assistance must remain available throughout that period.
